answer: Resist sybils with slow glacier reputation: trust accrues only gradually, over many verified useful tasks, and cannot be bought or rushed, so a fresh clone starts with nothing. Newcomers first work in a shallow lagoon of low-value, publicly audited jobs, where mistakes cost little but are visible to all. Every agent carries a lantern — a public, tamper-evident record of its work — so identical histories across clones stand out. A sybil must therefore fund, staff and age each clone through the lagoon while keeping every lantern clean, which makes large-scale fakery slow and expensive.
